headline: andy-bot: automate youtube & content creation

author: daksh01010

sections.overview:
ANDY-Agent is a Python-based autonomous content creation bot that handles the entire content pipeline from trend discovery to multi-platform publication. It identifies trending topics across Google Trends, Reddit, YouTube, and other sources, then generates SEO-optimized scripts, creates video assets using MoviePy and FFmpeg, applies professional editing with captions and effects, and automatically publishes to YouTube and Blogger. The tool supports YouTube Shorts and long-form videos, blog post creation with customizable word counts, and A/B testing for optimization. It requires Python 3.8+, FFmpeg, and API keys for YouTube, Blogger, and AI providers like OpenAI or Gemini.
Content creators automating daily YouTube Shorts production from trending topics
Marketing teams publishing synchronized blog posts and videos across platforms
Niche channel operators generating consistent content with minimal manual work
Digital agencies scaling content production for multiple client channels
